## Frequently Asked Questions

### Do you accept sponsored stays?

Not right now.

The whole point of The No Fluff Traveler is honest, independent travel writing. If that ever changes, sponsored or hosted stays will be clearly disclosed.
#notsponsored

### How do you decide what to review?

We focus on places that make claims about sustainability, conservation, local impact, or thoughtful travel — especially hotels, eco resorts, lodges, and unique stays.

### What does “No Fluff” mean?

It means we look past the marketing.

Beautiful photos, nice design, and sustainability buzzwords are not enough. We care about what a place actually does once you look closer.

### What do you look for in a sustainable stay?

We look at energy, water, food, local impact, conservation, transparency, and the overall guest experience.

A place does not have to be perfect. But it should be honest about what it is doing and where it still has work to do.

### Are the reviews based on personal experience?

Yes. Reviews are based on real stays, direct experience, research, and what we can reasonably verify.

### Do you only review luxury eco resorts?

No.

Luxury eco resorts are one part of the site, but The No Fluff Traveler is also interested in backcountry huts, family travel, outdoor destinations, small hotels, and places that are trying to do tourism better.

### What is greenwashing?

Greenwashing is when a place uses environmental or sustainability language to look responsible without backing it up with meaningful action.

Sometimes it is obvious.

Sometimes it is subtle.

That is why we look for specifics instead of vague claims.

### Can readers suggest places to review?

Absolutely.

If there is a place you think is doing thoughtful travel well — or a place making big claims that deserve a closer look — send it our way.

:::
